summary: Per-frame pit stop operation timing and sequence coordinator on the pit machine. Clears the operation-progress block, then either (active branch) advances the vehicle progress bar via ProgressBarIncrement and pushes the result through the physics channel, or (idle branch) computes the max duration of all pending operations — base time, tire/wheel part changes, crew part-group loop, tire-change state transitions, wheel-gun operations and audio/visual effect gates — from sampled flt_8AAE74 values, frame time bases, and vehicle gate flags. On pit-state transitions it dispatches ConditionalMathDispatch, NthValidPartLookup/CompoundIndexLookup part resolution, LoopWithConditionalSubCall, ProgressBarEventEncode, sub_4A35F0 channel processing and AudioSoundEffectController. Returns 0.0 while the vehicle pit state obj+0x32C8 equals 1 and PitStopBlockingCondition holds, otherwise the accumulated duration.
